body: The first bike was damaged by FedEx during transit before I received it, after being transferred through five facilities between California and Michigan and then returned to you. The replacement arrived in good condition after moving through three facilities. I can understand why damage insurance is offered, and I hope the shipping experience can be improved in the future.

Overall, I am very pleased with the bike, although the delivery and initial assembly process had a few challenges. The first bike was damaged by FedEx before I received it and was returned after being transferred through five facilities between California and Michigan. The replacement arrived in good condition after moving through three facilities. During assembly, I found that the left front brake cable had been routed around the right fork, which required unwrapping the cables, removing the front tire and handlebar, and repositioning the cable outside the left fork. I also removed and rotated the brake handle to eliminate a kink in the cable before rewrapping the cables and reinstalling the handlebar and front wheel. I love it! It's as good as some of the $4,000 bikes I was looking at.

The Premium Accessories Package has a nice set of just about anything you'll need. The only item I have an issue with is the Rear-view Mirror Set. The plastic ball-in-socket construction of the mirror to post attachment is NOT secure enough to hold mirrors in place. Tighten as best you can with the hex wrench, but (especially in warm weather when that plastic softens slightly) after just a few bumps, they will droop and fall out of position.
 The water bottle holder can only hold slim bottles, but it works. The front basket would benefit from an elastic cargo net to contain items.
 All other items function pretty well.

I feel I got a great deal for the price, shipping was very quick - ordered Sunday night online, received some accessories on Thursday, received bike with remaining accessories on Friday. Got the Puckipuppy Poodle with Premium Accessories Package (separate review). Assembly was not terribly difficult. There are some issues with the instruction manual - headings with wrong titles & some odd phrasing that may be translation issues, but with a little focus, one can figure it out.
 The ride is nice, and everything functions as I expect, with just some slippage of gears, which I'm confident can be fixed with derailer adjustment. Throttle acceleration is nicely responsive and a great boon for climbing hills.
 I do wish the display had two things: a Battery Level gauge and a real-time clock display.
 One issue I have is that the Setting to "Clear Trip Data" when selected as "YES" only clears the data that one time. It does not (as stated in the instructions) clear the trip data EVERY time the system is keyed off.
Super fast delivery, easy to assemble, well made, easy directions and fits both my Puckipuppy Corgis perfectly. It could use a loading ramp.
